verdict.rationale: The evidence shows React can stream HTML while server data is still loading and progressively fill in content (react-docs-6). Frameworks implementing React's architecture can also fetch data in async server components (react-docs-7). Together these imply a loading-aware data story, but nothing in the pack names a Suspense boundary, fallback UI, or resource-style primitive, and server data is never described as reactive state. Missing for 10: documented Suspense/fallback loading-UI primitive, resource or reactive-state primitive for server-loaded data, client-side async data handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
